title: RBTL West Herr Auditorium Theatre

services.name: Season Tickets
services.desc: Experience the best of Broadway in Rochester with a 7-show Subscription Package. RBTL’s mission is to provide opportunities for all people to experience, understand and enjoy the best in arts and performance. Each year, the Rochester Broadway Theatre League & Albert Nocciolino present The M&T Bank Broadway Season at the West Herr Auditorium Theatre, consisting of a series of touring Broadway shows. A Season Ticket Holder (Subscriber) purchases a Season Ticket Package (Subscription) which includes all Broadway shows in the series for one low price. Patrons choose the performance they wish to attend (Tuesday-Sunday, including matinees), and their preferred seating/pricing location.
